g.title: lessons
g.text: 14 · Lessons learned: failure → fix → standing test
from the 0.3.1 → 0.3.4 history and the M1.2 certification tooling

g.title: cluster_k
g.text: Kernel claims that were wrong

g.title: cluster_j
g.text: Journal bugs (0.3.2 / 0.3.3)

g.title: cluster_l
g.text: Liveness

g.title: cluster_t
g.text: Test-writing pitfalls

g.title: cluster_r
g.text: Release hygiene

g.title: cluster_p
g.text: Process lifetime (0.7.0)

g.title: k1
g.text: 0.3.1: ro-bind of / claimed 'no secret reads'
~/.ssh and docker.sock were reachable

g.title: k1f
g.text: Fix: empty tmpfs root + allowlisted ro binds
test: adversarial escape attempts

g.title: k2
g.text: 0.3.1: repetition halt left tool calls unanswered
(protocol invalid)

g.title: k2f
g.text: Fix: cancel remaining calls with replies
test P: 2000 fuzz scripts, one terminal reply each

g.title: j1
g.text: torn fragment swallowed the next record

g.title: jf
g.text: Fix: newline framing, mandatory crc, per-writer n == last+1,
transact under one exclusive lock
tests J2–J17 + 6-operator race in integration.sh

g.title: j2
g.text: records without crc accepted

g.title: j3
g.text: sorted sequence check let replays through

g.title: j4
g.text: operator writer ids collided; reconcile raced

g.title: l1
g.text: 0.3.3: every lock failure read as 'dead'

g.title: lf
g.text: 0.3.4: ALIVE / DEAD / UNKNOWN; unknown stays unresolved

g.title: t1
g.text: vacuous test: cat blocked on stdin
before reaching the leaked fd

g.title: tf
g.text: Rules: every test needs a mutant that fails it;
unique temp dirs; never self-matching patterns;
never auto-resolve uncertainty

g.title: t2
g.text: pgrep/pkill -f and awk patterns matched themselves
(once killed the test shell)

g.title: t3
g.text: fixed /tmp names broke root + non-root runs

g.title: t4
g.text: certifier auto-reconciled, against the uncertainty model;
SIGKILL fired before 'started' was durable

g.title: r1
g.text: 0.3.1–0.3.3 archives shipped a compiled test binary

g.title: rf
g.text: Fix: tools/release.sh refuses ELF files;
.gitignore + CI release-hygiene job

g.title: p1
g.text: killing only the outer bwrap right after start
orphaned the sandbox (PDEATHSIG not yet armed);
my first I16 tests passed because they only checked the outer pid

g.title: pf
g.text: Fix: SIGSTOP outer, enumerate descendants, SIGKILL all.
Tests look for survivors by a unique tag in /proc/*/cmdline,
kill 6 processes immediately after start

g.title: p2
g.text: raw cgroup files cannot be used: a login session is outside
user@UID.service and cannot be migrated (EACCES)

g.title: p2f
g.text: Fix: limits through systemd-run --user --scope (probed;
degrade visibly, or refuse with --cgroups:require)
